title: Admit approved Wave-amendment tasks to the governed UI lineage contract

trigger.denial: The UI evidence and backlog schemas accept only CAP-NN.SNN.TNN task identities, while the exact approved renderer task is the Wave-amendment task W1.A05.T04. The materialized task therefore also lacks the experience_change projection required by ui_change_gate.
trigger.atomicity: No product UI file has changed. The task-start acceptance worksheet is committed, W1.A05.T04 remains IN_PROGRESS at its original claim base, and the unrelated W1.A04.B00 witness remains untracked and untouched.
trigger.diagnosis: The governed UI lineage contract was built before post-migration product amendments became executable. Its identity grammar and bootstrap projection cover ordinary capability tasks but cannot represent an already approved amendment task even when the human-approved reference, immutable task, owner, and claim base are all present.

authority: This maintenance preserves the exact approved W1.A05 task, acceptance criteria, T03 security authority, RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.4 package, human approval, task owner, claim base, Wave state, release gate, and protected history. It does not approve implementation, add a sign-in mode, change the governed experience, expand product or security authority, complete a task or slice, approve G1, authorize an external effect, or rewrite any prior approval, submission, review, finding, closure, or evidence.

intendedDelta.implementation: Extend the existing UI evidence identity and contract-path grammar, enabler-task property allowlist, active-task discovery, and exact task lookup generically so ordinary CAP-NN.SNN.TNN tasks and Wave-amendment WN.ANN.TNN tasks use the same experience_change contract. Project onto W1.A05.T04 only the exact approved-reference-implementation lineage already fixed by the v1.4 package. Add one generic, fail-closed pre-implementation maintenance attestation: a Tier-2 candidate must be the direct child of its frozen predecessor, enumerate its exact changed paths, receive an immutable no-finding independent review in the direct child commit, preserve every authority field byte-for-byte, and have that review precede every UI implementation commit. Keep ui_change_gate's active state, owner, exact base, reference hash, approval ancestry, changed-file inventory, and one-contract equality checks unchanged.
failClosed: No other task namespace, free-form identifier, malformed segment width, missing task, inactive task, wrong owner, wrong base, wrong reference, wrong approval commit, or mismatched contract path becomes admissible.
The amendment task remains bound to its original bd8d752 claim base and exact approved W1.A05 definition; this maintenance does not alter packet_task_sha256 or immutable packet fields.
Product UI remains blocked until the separately committed T04 implementation adds its exact evidence contract and passes the unchanged full ui_change_gate lineage checks.
The CAP task grammar and every existing UI lineage invariant remain accepted unchanged.

verification.riskAnalysis: This changes evidence/control identity grammar but no product runtime. Selected checks must prove the same exact lineage contract for one amendment task, preserve the ordinary CAP path, reject malformed identities through both schemas, validate the canonical backlog and approved amendment authority, regenerate deterministic views, pass the complete focused UI gate suite and governed Python quality, and leave the product/reference trees unchanged. Product, native, renderer, packaging, performance, and W1-exit checks remain assigned to T04, S02 review, amendment exit, and Wave exit after this control gate is independently approved.

results.check: complete focused UI lineage gate suite
results.detail: All 25 unittest cases passed, including real amendment-task lookup and automatic-base selection, exact v1.4-style approved-reference implementation, out-of-range Wave denial, independently reviewed and remediated pre-implementation maintenance admission, plain and namespaced self-review denial, post-approval record-substitution denial, unchanged CAP behavior, task/base/reference equality, regular-blob enforcement, and existing hardening invariants.

results.check: canonical backlog schema and workflow validation
results.detail: All 27 taskctl schema tests passed and taskctl validate accepted the exact live backlog with W1.A05.T04 still IN_PROGRESS at its original bd8d752 claim base.
planctl wave ready W1 --require-approved accepted all W1 capability/slice plans and regenerated the planning site without changing product or reference files.

The exact RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.4 package remained approved and reproducible across 55 governed files and 33 product pages at package SHA-256 034d592ea97c35113ac802f885a469f89f9c72ad2548740347bef00f7484310e.

results.check: generated views and governed Python quality
results.detail: backlog_views and plan_review_site completed deterministically; Ruff formatting and lint passed for the changed gate tool and regression suite; exact changed-path patch hygiene passed.

remediation.rootCause: The first candidate normalized only the reviewer namespace before comparing identities and modeled only a one-round approval path. The first remediation then compared only selected projection fields, leaving other approved remediation and closure bytes substitutable after review. The evidence narrative also retained pre-expansion suite counts.
remediation.resolution: Use one validated canonical agent-identity function for both roles, reject equal canonical identities, and authenticate an append-only sequence in which the first candidate is the direct child of the frozen predecessor, each adverse review is the exact reviewed record plus only the canonical status/attempt/review projection in the reviewed commit's direct child, each remediation is the next direct child, and the final adopted record is byte-identical to the final review-introduction commit. Correct the complete-suite counts to the executed 25 UI-gate and 27 taskctl-schema tests.
remediation.recurrenceControl: Real-Git regressions now reject self-review for both plain and agent:-namespaced implementers, prove adverse-ledger/remediation/approval ordering, and reject post-approval substitution of remediation or closure bytes before UI implementation.

rollback: Do not begin product UI work or integrate this candidate if independent review finds a blocking defect. Revert only the strict-descendant maintenance candidate to predecessor 212108b; W1.A05.T04 remains claimed but product-unmodified, the approved v1.4 package remains unchanged, and no task/release authority changes.
